tagline.en: The Capital Beltway — the ring that named a political class
tagline.zh: 首都环线：一条环路，命名了一个政治阶层

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 2, January 2026

en: The Capital Beltway is a 64-mile ring around Washington, but only part of it is signed as I-495 alone. On the eastern side the loop carries I-95 as well, and that mileage is counted against I-95 in the federal route log; what is left as plain I-495 is 31.49 miles, 16.13 in Maryland and 15.36 in Virginia, running the western arc from the Woodrow Wilson Bridge round through Springfield, Tysons, Bethesda and Silver Spring. The even hundreds digit is correct here: it is a loop off I-95 and hands the traffic back.

The road has done something no other Interstate has managed, which is to enter the language. 'Inside the Beltway' has meant the federal political world for decades, and the metaphor works because the ring really is a boundary: the agencies, contractors and suburbs that grew up along it after 1964 face inwards. In traffic terms it is a commuter road that was designed as a bypass, with the usual consequences.
zh: 首都环线是环绕华盛顿的 64 英里环路，但只有其中一部分单独标为 I-495。东侧路段同时挂 I-95，那部分里程在联邦路线名录中计入 I-95；余下纯 I-495 的部分为 31.49 英里，其中马里兰州 16.13 英里、弗吉尼亚州 15.36 英里，即自伍德罗·威尔逊大桥起，经斯普林菲尔德、泰森斯、贝塞斯达与银泉的西弧段。这里的偶数百位是对的：它是 I-95 的环线，并把车流交还给母线。
这条路做到了别的州际公路都没做到的事——进入了日常语言。「环线之内」（Inside the Beltway）几十年来就是联邦政治圈的代称，这个比喻成立，是因为这个环确实是一条边界：1964 年之后沿它成长起来的各类机构、承包商与郊区，面孔都朝内。就交通而言，它是一条按绕行线设计、却当通勤路用的道路，后果也就是通常那一套。

en: The two states raced each other to finish. The 22-mile Virginia section opened on 2 April 1964 at a cost of $56.6 million; the 41-mile Maryland section followed on 16 August 1964 at $96.4 million. The river crossings came first: the original Woodrow Wilson Bridge opened in December 1961, and the American Legion Bridge over the Potomac gorge at Cabin John, a $2.8 million structure, opened in December 1962.

What opened was narrower than the road people picture. Between the Shirley Highway interchange at Springfield and VA 193 at McLean the beltway had two lanes in each direction; the rest of it, in both states, had three. Widening began almost immediately and has never really stopped, and in 1989 Virginia started what became more than fifteen years of studies into what to do with its 22 miles.
zh: 两州当年在抢工期。弗吉尼亚段 22 英里于 1964 年 4 月 2 日通车，造价 5,660 万美元；马里兰段 41 英里于同年 8 月 16 日建成，造价 9,640 万美元。过河的桥梁先行：最初的伍德罗·威尔逊大桥于 1961 年 12 月通车，横跨卡宾约翰波托马克河峡谷的美国军团大桥造价 280 万美元，于 1962 年 12 月通车。
当时开通的道路比今天人们想象的窄得多。斯普林菲尔德的雪莉公路立交至麦克莱恩的 VA 193 之间，环线只有双向各两车道；其余路段在两州境内均为三车道。拓宽几乎立刻开始，并且从未真正停止；1989 年弗吉尼亚州启动了对本州 22 英里路段的研究，一研究就是十五年以上。

en: Virginia's answer, adopted in January 2005, was to buy new capacity from a private consortium rather than build it with tax money. VDOT signed a partnership agreement with Fluor and Transurban in December 2007 to design, build, finance, operate and maintain four high-occupancy toll lanes down the middle of fourteen miles of beltway, under an 85-year concession: five years of construction and eighty of operation.

The project cost $2.068 billion, which included replacing more than $260 million of ageing infrastructure — over fifty bridges and overpasses came down and went back up. Construction started in spring 2008 and the 495 Express Lanes opened on 17 November 2012, with tolls varying by the minute and no cash accepted. A 2.5-mile extension north through McLean to the George Washington Memorial Parkway opened on 22 November 2025.
zh: 弗吉尼亚州在 2005 年 1 月给出的答案，是向私人财团购买新增通行能力，而不是用税款自建。2007 年 12 月，弗州交通部与 Fluor 和 Transurban 签署合作协议，由对方设计、建造、融资、运营并养护环线中段十四英里内的四条高乘载收费车道，特许期 85 年：五年施工，八十年运营。
项目造价 20.68 亿美元，其中包括更换价值 2.6 亿美元以上的老旧设施——五十多座桥梁与跨线桥被拆除重建。工程于 2008 年春开工，495 快速收费车道于 2012 年 11 月 17 日通车，收费标准按分钟浮动，且不收现金。向北经麦克莱恩延伸至乔治·华盛顿纪念公园路的 2.5 英里延长段，于 2025 年 11 月 22 日通车。

why.en: Volumes are published separately by Maryland and Virginia for individual segments and differ sharply between the American Legion Bridge, the Tysons section and the Maryland suburbs. Neither state publishes a figure for the I-495-only mileage as a unit.
why.zh: 马里兰州与弗吉尼亚州分别按路段发布交通量，美国军团大桥、泰森斯路段与马里兰郊区之间差异很大。两州都没有把单独标为 I-495 的里程作为整体发布数据。

timeline.en: The original Woodrow Wilson Bridge opens across the Potomac.
timeline.zh: 最初的伍德罗·威尔逊大桥跨波托马克河通车。

timeline.en: Virginia completes its 22 miles in April and Maryland its 41 miles in August, closing the ring.
timeline.zh: 弗吉尼亚州 4 月建成本州 22 英里，马里兰州 8 月建成 41 英里，环线合拢。

timeline.en: The 495 Express Lanes open after four and a half years of construction.
timeline.zh: 历经四年半施工，495 快速收费车道通车。

timeline.en: A 2.5-mile extension of the toll lanes opens north through McLean.
timeline.zh: 收费车道向北经麦克莱恩延长 2.5 英里通车。
